title: gates config
description: Config for the baseline-aware local gate runner. Point your editor at this file with "$schema": "./gates/gates.schema.json" to get completion and validation while you type.

$schema.description: Path to this schema file, relative to the config.

_comment.description: JSON has no comments. Any key starting with an underscore is ignored, so use it for notes.

baselineDir.description: Where baselines are stored, relative to the config file. Layout is <baselineDir>/<project>/<gate>.txt. Commit this directory.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-gate timeout in milliseconds. A gate that needs more than a few minutes belongs in CI, not in a local gate.

projects.description: One entry per buildable unit. In a monorepo that is usually one per top-level directory.

name.description: Project name. Becomes a directory name under baselineDir, and the value for --project.

cwd.description: Directory the gate commands run in, relative to the config file.

paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes that belong to this project. --only-changed skips the project when git reports no change under any of them. Defaults to [cwd].

gates.description: Gates in ladder order: cheapest and fastest first, so the common failure surfaces in seconds.

id.description: Gate id, unique inside its project. Becomes the baseline file name, and the value for --gate.

description.description: One short line shown next to the gate in the report.

run.description: The shell command. It runs through a shell, so pipes, quotes and VAR=value prefixes all work. node_modules/.bin of the gate cwd is prepended to PATH.

parser.description: How to turn output into stable failure keys. Use exit-code for any tool with no machine-readable output; it produces no keys, so it cannot be baselined.

baseline.description: Compare against a recorded baseline and fail only on NEW failures. Defaults to true for every parser except exit-code. Set false to make any failure fatal.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this gate only.

cwd.description: Override the project cwd for this one gate. Relative to the config file.

reportFile.description: Read the parser input from this file instead of stdout. Required for junit-xml, where it may be a single XML file or a directory to walk. Useful for vitest and eslint when the command writes to --outputFile.

allowedExitCodes.description: Exit codes that mean the tool ran normally. Default is [0]. A test runner that exits 1 on failures still ran normally, so add 1 there when the runner would otherwise be treated as crashed.
